message.name: SecuritiesBalanceAccountingReport002V11
message.definition: Scope |An account servicer sends a SecuritiesBalanceAccountingReport to an account owner to provide, at a moment in time, valuations of the portfolio together with details of each financial instrument holding.|The account servicer/owner relationship may be:|- an accounting agent acting on behalf of an account owner, or|- a transfer agent acting on behalf of a fund manager or an account owner's designated agent.||Usage|The message should be sent at a frequency agreed bi-laterally between the account servicer and the account owner.|The message can be sent either audited or un-audited and may be provided on a trade date, contractual or settlement date basis. |This message can only be used to list the holdings of a single (master) account. However, it is possible to break down these holdings into one or several sub-accounts. Therefore, the message can be used to either specify holdings at|- the main account level, or, |- the sub-account level.|This message can be used to report where the financial instruments are safe-kept, physically or notionally. If a security is held in more than one safekeeping place, this can also be indicated. |The SecuritiesBalanceAccountingReport message should not be used for trading purposes.|There may be one or more intermediary parties, for example, an intermediary or a concentrator between the account owner and account servicer.|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

rules.name: ReportNumberRule
rules.text: If Long number (Exact5NumericTest) is used, then the report must be a delta reports (UpdateType: DELT).|If the report has multiple pages, then the ReportNumber must remain the same through all the pages. It is a unique number to the report.|Two reports of the same type sent one after the other to the same receiver in relation to the same safekeeping account must have different ReportNumbers. For example, a daily report sent on day 1 would have ReportNumber 001, on day 2, 002, etc.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline
rules.text: When a ISIN code exist. It is strongly recommended that the ISIN be used.

rules.name: DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule
rules.text: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.

rules.name: PlaceOfListingRule
rules.text: If PlaceOfListing is used and an ISO 10383 MIC exists for the market to be identified, the ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code (MIC) must be used.

rules.name: AdditionalDetailsRule
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, if FinancialInstrumentAttributeAdditionalDetails is present, then it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: SafekeepingPlaceFormatOrLEIRule
rules.text: SafekeepingPlaceFormat must be present or LEI must be present.

rules.name: ValueRule
rules.text: If TypeOfPriceCode is not MRKT, then Value  may not be expressed with UnknownIndicator.

rules.name: SubBalanceAdditionalDetailsRule
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, if SubBalanceAdditionnalDetails is used, them it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: EligibleForCollateralPurposesRule
rules.text: If Subbalance type is EligibleForCollateralPurposes, then QuantityAndAvailability cannot be used.

rules.name: SubBalanceAdditionalDetailsRule
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, if SubBalanceAdditionnalDetails is used, them it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: AvailableWithNoStatusRule
rules.text: If Subbalance type is AvailableWithNoStatus, then QuantityAndAvailability cannot be used.

rules.name: PledgeeTypeAndIdentificationOrLEIRule
rules.text: PledgeeTypeAndIdentification must be present or LEI must be present.

rules.name: AggregateBalanceGuideline
rules.text: If AvailableQuantity and NotAvailableQuantity are both present, then the AggregateQuantity should be the sum of AvailableQuantity and NotAvailableQuantity.

rules.name: HoldingAdditionalDetailsRule
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, if SubBalanceAdditionnalDetails is present, then it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: BalanceAtSafekeepingPlaceRule
rules.text: If SafekeepingPlace is present, then BalanceAtSafekeepingPlace is not allowed.

rules.name: HoldingAdditionalDetailsRule
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, if SubBalanceAdditionnalDetails is present, then it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: FinancialInstrumentAttributesRule
rules.text: If InvestmentFundsFinancialInstrumentAttributes is present, then FinancialInstrumentAttributes is not allowed.

rules.name: SubSafekeepingReportingRule
rules.text: Use of consolidated reports on a sub-safekeeping account must be bilaterally agreed between sender and receiver.

rules.name: ActivityAndBalanceForSubAccount1Rule
rules.text: If the ActivityIndicator is TRUE (Yes), then at least one occurrence of BalanceForSubAccount must be present.

rules.name: ActivityAndBalanceForSubAccount2Rule
rules.text: If the ActivityIndicator is FALSE (No), then BalanceForSubAccount must not be present.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rule
rules.text: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rule
rules.text: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Rule
rules.text: Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.

rules.name: BalanceForAccountOrSubAccountDetailsRule
rules.text: If StatementGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is TRUE (Yes), then either BalanceForAccount or SubAccountDetails must be present. If StatementGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is FALSE (No), then BalanceForAccount and SubAccountDetails must be absent.

rules.name: BalanceForAccountReportingRule
rules.text: If StatementGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is TRUE (Yes) and SubAccountIndicator is FALSE (NO), then BalanceForAccount must be present and Sub Account Details must be absent.

rules.name: SecuritiesMarketPracticeGroupGuideline
rules.text: The Securities Market Practice Group (SMPG) has published market practice recommendations on the use of this message.|These market practices are available on www.smpg.info.

rules.name: SubAccountDetailsBalanceForAccountPresenceRule
rules.text: If StatementGeneralDetails/ActivityIndicator is TRUE (Yes) and SubAccountIndicator is TRUE (YES), then SubAccountDetails must be present and BalanceForAccount must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rule
rules.text: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rule
rules.text: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Rule
rules.text: Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.
